summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric services company, reporting that credit rating agency S&P reaffirmed its national scale issuer credit ratings at brAAA/brA-1+ and revised the company's management and governance assessment from negative to neutral. The filing also notes the affirmation of ratings for subsidiaries. No transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, or other special situation is disclosed. This is a routine credit rating update, not a special situation event.
